title: Galileon Gravity (Nicolis–Rattazzi–Trincherini)
efc_relevance: Scalar with Galilean shift-symmetry; self-accelerating cosmology, Vainshtein screening locally. Sub-class of Horndeski. Produces enhanced growth (μ > 1) — again opposite sign to EFC prediction, enabling FA2-type discriminator. Cubic galileon self-accelerating branch strongly constrained by ISW cross-correlation.
ledger_action: Logged as Horndeski sub-class with enhanced growth. FA2 discriminator applies.
